reason: This plugin is primarily a planning-and-execution workbench for DeepSeek Harness Web, focused on task management in calendar/list views with AI-assisted clarify, breakdown, execution, and review flows. The evidence shows its main value is organizing and executing personal work tasks with supporting report, reminder, and knowledge-capture features rather than generic development tooling.

summaries.zh: 这是一个面向 DSH Web 的个人工作台插件，提供日历与树状任务管理，并支持自然语言录入后结合 AI 进行任务澄清、拆解、执行和复盘，同时提供提醒与日报周报等工作流功能。
summaries.en: This DeepSeek Harness Web plugin provides a personal workbench for calendar and hierarchical task management, with natural-language task intake and AI-assisted clarify, breakdown, execution, and review flows plus reminders and report generation.

capabilities: Hierarchical task creation and management with calendar/list/today views
AI-generated scheduling and reporting for selected dates
Local persistence of workbench data via SQLite/JSON backup path
Desktop reminder notifications and recurring task handling
Per-task knowledge and idea capture with search

reasons.code: Task and AI workflow features are user-facing and stateful, which can alter local task status and records.
The plugin performs AI-enabled execution and workspace interactions via configured DSH models, which can consume API/token resources and trigger operational side effects.
Workbench data is stored locally under ~/.dsh/workbench and APIs are exposed on /api/workbench with loopback-only access, indicating limited but non-zero local/host-risk surface.
